Research internship to quantify localization errors in camera-based object detection, with potential extensions to LiDAR and multi-sensor fusion. Work uses simulated and real data in the RAP team at LAAS-CNRS, Toulouse. Requires a Master’s or engineering student with Python/C++, machine learning and computer vision skills. Apply with CV, motivation letter and Master’s grades using the source page. Applications are reviewed continuously; no closing date is specified. Appointment requires approval for access to the restricted research zone.
